text:
sasha: Hey team — Acme SIG is due EOD tomorrow. I pulled the questionnaire and started a mapping in the spreadsheet but we need question-by-question evidence. Can people add artifacts or give a short thumbs-up if we already have it? cc @olivia @james @michelle :wave:

olivia: I can own crypto/KMS and key rotation answers. Where should I drop the PDFs?

james: Put them in the shared drive folder I created: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AcmeSIG2026 (permissions set to Redwood-sales internal). I'll update the spreadsheet link column.

michelle: I have the SOC2 control mapping and the network diagrams ready. Uploading now as `redwood_acme_network_diagram_v2.pdf` and `soc2_control_map_acme.xlsx`.

ryan: Note — Acme specifically asked for MFA screenshots for admin console and evidence of RBAC. I can take screenshots and the admin role export.

olivia: Awesome. For KMS I have two artifacts: `kms_rotation_policy.pdf` and `kms_rotation_logs_2025.zip` (redacted). Dropping both to the drive now.

james: Quick Q on question 4.2 (encryption in transit): do we point them to TLS1.2+ in our public endpoints and to service-to-service mTLS for internal traffic? Any config snippets to include?

michelle: Yes — TLS1.2+ for public API. For mTLS we have the bootstrap snippet (I pasted it in the spreadsheet notes). I'll also attach the `mtls_config_snippet.txt` so they can validate.

sasha: Perfect. Two open items I still see: (1) Evidence of data residency for EU customers (they want copy of our data residency SOP and proof of region pinning); (2) Verified vulnerability management cadence (scan reports + ticketing).

olivia: For data residency we have `data_residency_sop.pdf` and the export of cluster tags showing `region=eu-west-1`. Uploading both.

ryan: For vuln mgmt I'll attach last quarter's external scan report and the JIRA export for remediation tickets: `external_scan_Q4_2025.pdf` and `vuln_remediation_jira_export.csv`. I'm still pulling the timelines for SLA on critical fixes.

michelle: FYI Acme asks about third-party penetration test vendor and PoC results. We did a blackbox pentest in 2025 with RedPen. I'll attach the executive summary (redacted).

james: Do we want to provide a short cover note that maps each SIG question to a file name? I can draft a 1-page mapping to reduce back-and-forth.

sasha: Yes please — that would speed review. James, can you draft and post it here? If you can get it done in the next 30m I will attach it to the packet before submission.

james: On it. Drafting now.

sig-bot: Reminder — SIG submission window closes at 23:59 UTC tomorrow. Check the checklist: `Checklist: questionnaire + evidence mapping + redactions done + contact person`.

james: Uploaded `acme_sig_evidence_map_draft.docx` to the drive and linked it in the spreadsheet. Tagging owners in the doc comments.

olivia: Reviewed the mapping, left two comments on item 7 (KMS rotation frequency clarifications).

michelle: I redacted commercial IP from the pentest summary and uploaded `pentest_exec_summary_redacted.pdf`.

ryan: Screenshots and RBAC export uploaded as `admin_mfa_screenshots.zip` and `rbac_admin_export.csv`.

sasha: Amazing work, team. I will do a final sweep and submit first thing tomorrow morning. If anyone finds a missing item, drop it in the spreadsheet and ping me here. :thumbsup:
